title: SDUI Payload (v1.1)
description: Authoritative STRUCTURAL schema for @fajekrina/sdui payloads. Derived from murti.schema.json v1 (Apache-2.0, see NOTICE); v1.1 additions are additive only, so every murti v1 payload stays valid. It enforces shape, closed vocabularies, and per-field bounds. Tree depth, total node count, action-chain depth, load-request count, and semantic resolution (a type/request/screen actually exists) are enforced by the client validator — see spec/README.md.

envelope.description: Production transport wrapper. The client verifies the signature (and optionally decrypts) BEFORE trusting the payload.

alg.description: Signature algorithm. The app verifies with its embedded public key.

keyId.description: v1.1 — which signing key produced the signature (key rotation). Absent: the single configured key.

enc.description: Present ONLY when the payload is encrypted (hybrid/envelope encryption). Absent means signed-but-plaintext.

payload.description: Base64 of the UTF-8 payload JSON, or of the ciphertext when 'enc' is present. ~1 MiB cap.

signature.description: Base64 signature over the raw (pre-base64) 'payload' bytes.

payload.description: Plaintext screen tree — inside the envelope, or posted directly during development.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR. Consumers match on MAJOR; an unknown MINOR renders-what-it-can (forward-compatible).

key.description: Stable screen key. Must resolve in the ScreenFactory (a semantic check the client performs).

load.description: v1.1 — named requests run in PARALLEL when the screen opens; each result merges into the data context under its request name. The client bound maxLoadRequests applies.

variants.description: v1.1 — optional per-width layouts (compact < 600px ≤ wide). 'root' stays the fallback.

node.description: A node. 'type' is an OPEN vocabulary (the component registry is extensible); the client's semantic layer confirms it resolves, otherwise the Null-Object fallback renders a placeholder.

id.description: Optional stable identity for rendering. Synthesized from the position if absent.

props.description: A component's props bag. OPEN by design: unknown keys are ignored (forward-compatible). String values are length-bounded via #/$defs/value.

value.description: Any JSON scalar/array/object. Strings are length-bounded wherever they appear.

action.description: An action. 'type' is a CLOSED vocabulary. onSuccess/onError form a bounded LINEAR chain (max depth enforced by the client validator). Targets are named references (screen key / named request / named link / named native command) — never raw URLs.

presentation.description: v1.1 — navigate: how the host presents the next screen. Default push.

request.description: api: an allow-listed NamedRequest, mapped to method + path by the app bundle.

link.description: openURL: an allow-listed NAMED link. Not a raw URL — the identifier pattern structurally rejects 'https://...'.

command.description: v1.1 — native: a host command allow-listed by the app (e.g. biometricConfirm, share).

params.description: Seeds the target's data context (navigate) or supplies request/command params (api/native). String values may be {{token}}s.

identifier.description: A named reference (screen key, request, link, command). Alphanumeric + underscore; the pattern rejects URLs, paths, and injection.

typeName.description: A component type. Dots allowed for third-party namespacing, e.g. 'ext.lottie'.
